act2/after_rats.title: After the Rats
act2/after_rats.body: Dark viscera on your heel. A **small victory** — but enough to breathe.

act2/camp/camp_companion_chat.title: Words by the fire

choices.text: Listen to Mira without the stone judging
Mira meets your eyes — someone who recognizes a wall on your shoulder
Mira measures your arcanist silence — she does not judge, she notes
Mira: «The Vigil speaks loud; you listen too softly for it to be mere dogma»
Tomás: «Heavy honor pushes people into holes — are you whole?»
Tomás hesitates: «Tower and dungeon — which eats you first?»
Tomás lowers his voice: «A watchman's faith is serious; do not use it as a wall»

act2/camp/camp_mira_fireside.title: Embers — words with Mira
act2/camp/camp_mira_fireside.body:
**Mira** does not sit like a soldier: she slides to the ground, knees to chest, eyes on the flame — and on your **jaw**, the city still **weighs**.

> *"Speak quickly. The fire **hears** better than stone — and I hear better than both."*

---

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Ask what she no longer steals from the dark
Speak of the Vigil as one speaks softly
Share silence — only the crackle of wood

act2/camp/camp_mira_topic_shadows.title: What stays in the dark
act2/camp/camp_mira_topic_shadows.body:
> *"I steal what gives me my name back," she says, without looking at you. "Fear, sometimes. Hope, when it weighs little. The rest I leave **on the ground** — someone will find it and call it treasure."*

A spark bites the air. She finally smiles sideways:

> *"You leave **promises** in the dark. I **know** the weight when you pretend it is light."*
---

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Let the matter die in the embers

act2/camp/camp_mira_topic_silence.title: Shared silence
act2/camp/camp_mira_topic_silence.body:
You say nothing. Neither does she. The camp noise recedes; only the crackle of wood and the false warmth on your skin remain.

When Mira speaks, it is almost a gentle insult:

> *"See? **This** is how you make a truce."*

---

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Breathe and return to what matters
diaryTexts: Beside the Vigil's fire, Mira and I measured the world in silence — and for once the silence asked no name.

act2/camp/camp_mira_topic_vigilia.title: The Vigil by the fire
act2/camp/camp_mira_topic_vigilia.body:
> *"The Vigil loves **order**," murmurs Mira. "Order is history written by whoever survived the first blackout. I am not on that page — but your fire **needs** someone who knows how to read shadows."*

She lifts her chin toward the soldiers in the back.

> *"Do not trust them. Use them. It is different."*
---

{{companionLine}}

act2/camp/camp_tomas_fireside.title: Embers — words with Tomás
act2/camp/camp_tomas_fireside.body:
**Tomás** sets the shield on the earth as one who marks a boundary; your **posture** has already told him *why* — only **words** remain that do not shame those who stay above.

> *"If you came for pity, save your breath. If you came for **words**, speak — the fire will not interrupt out of courtesy."*

---

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Ask if the shield still weighs
Speak of the order that ceased to exist

act2/camp/camp_tomas_topic_oath.title: Oath without master
act2/camp/camp_tomas_topic_oath.body:
> *"The order did not die in a day," says Tomás. "It **forgot** names — first the dead, then the living. I still say the prayers. I do not know if anyone hears."*

He wipes soot from the metal with his thumb.

> *"As long as you rise **before** I fall, the oath holds. After that… it is only iron."*
---

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Leave the past in the embers

act2/camp/camp_tomas_topic_shield.title: The weight of the shield
act2/camp/camp_tomas_topic_shield.body:
He looks at the marks on the leather as one reading a crooked genealogy.

> *"It weighs what I **failed** to stop. The rest is wood and nails — any smith can mend that."*

A second later, lower:

> *"You carry too much as well. Do not grow used to calling it honor."*
---

{{companionLine}}

act2/camp/manage_equip.title: Iron and oaths
act2/camp/manage_equip.body:
Straps creak, buckles bite leather, and metal answers with a tired gleam.

Here, far from the first blow, you have a moment to adjust **weapon**, **armor**, and **relics** before moving on.

act2/camp/vigilia_camp.title: Vigil Camp
act2/camp/vigilia_camp.body:
Soldiers of the **Vigil** share dry bread. Honor tastes of ash.

*With no sun for reference, the stone still records: **day {{day}}**.*

choices.lockedHint: You need at least 1 supply to pay for rest.

choices.text: Exchange a few words with the group
choices.lockedHint: Without a companion, there is no group to talk to.

choices.text: Ask the group how many days you've been below
choices.preview: Count aloud; the echo does not lie.
choices.lockedHint: You need a companion and at least four days underground for that conversation.

choices.text: Scratch the day into damp earth
choices.preview: An entry in the diary.
diaryTexts: You scratched day {{day}} into the earth. The clock above no longer commands.

choices.text: Report a Cult mark to the officer (−1 cult)
choices.preview: Reputation trade · Vigil slow, Cult immediate (once)
diaryTexts: I spoke too loudly about the Third Bell — the officer noted it as a small victory.

act2/catacomb_entry.title: Cross of bones
act2/catacomb_entry.body:
A **cross** of fine bones points to three paths. Melted candles left **rivers of black wax** on the floor — someone was here not long ago.

The echo **lies** about distance: one step sounds like three.

choices.text: Follow the chalk mark on the floor
Stop at the crossroads and open the hub
Study the ceiling: drips, roots, runes?

act2/catacomb_observe.title: Ceiling
act2/catacomb_observe.body:
**Drips** draw threads in the air. Between the stones, thin **roots** reach for what sunlight no longer gives.

On the ceiling, a **rune** was scraped away and replaced with an **X** — someone wanted to erase the right direction.

act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual.title: Circle Ritual
act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual.body: A mage of the **Circle** draws ash on the floor. "A light price," he says.

choices.preview: Accept the ash — or hesitate and withdraw.

choices.text: Sing the refrain as a Circle devotee
choices.preview: More ash, more echo — the day advances.
Mind — keep clarity when refusing (TN 8)

act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.title: Trapped gaze
act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.body:
You step back, but for an instant you **see** the design **complete** on your retina — a **ghost** of commitment you never asked for.

No **mark** remained… but an **echo** did.

act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.title: Quiet refusal
act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.body:
You refuse the **circle** — but the pattern on the floor **pulls** your gaze, as if the lines wanted to **continue** inside you.

To leave **whole**, you need **clarity**: a straight line in your head that is not his.
act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.skillCheckLabel: Keep your mind steady when refusing the ritual

act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.title: No signature
act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.body: The ash **stops** at your feet — nothing is written on you. The silence, this time, is **yours**.

act2/cruzeiro_echo_once.title: Wax and copper
act2/cruzeiro_echo_once.body: Between **two** spent candles, the **wax** held a **coin** with its face scraped away: neither a full coin, nor a whole lie — only proof that someone **paid** to stay a little warmer.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I pried an old coin from the wax — change from someone who prayed and fled.

act2/encounters/rats_combat_intro.title: Before the leap
act2/encounters/rats_combat_intro.body:
The floor **vibrates** — not from your fear, but from **claws** digging soft stone.

The rats **do not flee**. They advance in an arc, as if someone taught them **formation**.

Clench your teeth. The **dice** will count what flesh refuses to admit.

act2/encounters/trial_fallen_angel_gate.title: Veil trial
act2/encounters/trial_fallen_angel_gate.body:
From the **ash** rises a **silhouette** that was once too much light for one body — it asks no forgiveness, only **proof**.

*Whoever would claim a name of fall, shadow, or penance must defeat what fell and still cuts* — no **shortcut**: steel, arcane, or prayer, or **return** without title.

choices.preview: Combat · enemy advantage

choices.text: Face the angel with the arcane (mage)
choices.preview: Combat · enemy advantage
Combat · enemy advantage

act2/encounters/wild_encounter_bones_rar.title: Bones without choir
act2/encounters/wild_encounter_bones_rar.body: A lone **skeleton** rises at the junction, without chant and without haste. When it sees you, it points its blade as one fulfilling an old oath.

act2/encounters/wild_encounter_cultist.title: Lone patrol
act2/encounters/wild_encounter_cultist.body: A **cultist** too confident separates from the choir. His voice **trembles** — not from fear, from cheap **ecstasy**.

choices.text: Whisper the name of the Third Bell — buy mutual silence
choices.preview: No combat · gold and XP (once)
diaryTexts: The cultist closed his eyes as one hearing distance; when he opened them, he was no longer there — only the rumor of coin.

act2/encounters/wild_encounter_lone_swar.title: Broken nest
act2/encounters/wild_encounter_lone_swar.body: Beneath loose planks, a **swarm** without a den runs in circles, wounded and furious. Its hunger still bites like a whole choir.

act2/encounters/wild_encounter_mixed.title: Mixed cell
act2/encounters/wild_encounter_mixed.body: **Rat** and **skeleton** share the same floor — as if death and life had agreed on a **price**.

act2/encounters/wild_encounter_rats.title: Double swarm
act2/encounters/wild_encounter_rats.body: Two **vortices** of teeth close the corridor on you. This is no ambush of men — it is organized **hunger**.

act2/faction/circulo_envoy.title: Living ash — Circle
act2/faction/circulo_envoy.body:
**Ash** rises from the floor like the **breath** of one who died once and liked the silence.

*"The Circle **lends** form," a voice says. "Whoever **tears** pays in cheap blood."*

choices.text: Let the Circle close a favorable symbol
choices.preview: Temporary bonus · MIND
diaryTexts: The ash prickled on my palm and then stilled — a loan from the Circle, with interest in silence.

choices.text: Tear the design before it closes
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation (draft); failure leads to combat.

act2/faction/circulo_envoy_blades.title: Living ash — iron
act2/faction/circulo_envoy_blades.body: [DRAFT] The **ash** **bites**. The **Circle** collects **by hand** what it **could not** collect by **voice**.

choices.text: Tear the design before it closes
choices.preview: Combat · bone adept

act2/faction/circulo_envoy_verbal_win.title: Living ash — word
act2/faction/circulo_envoy_verbal_win.body: [DRAFT] The design **closes** without **bite**. You hear the **loan** **sleep** in the air, like **held** **breath**.
onEnterDiaryTexts: [DRAFT] The Circle accepted the tone — ash that retreats without forgiving for free.

act2/faction/culto_envoy.title: Bell flesh — Cult
act2/faction/culto_envoy.body:
A **bell** without clapper vibrates in the tunnel's **throat**. The shadow **bends** the knee before you do.

*"A devotee is one who **pays** silence with another silence."*

choices.text: Confess as high debtor — the bell collects and pays
choices.preview: Gold, XP and corruption · cult favor (once)
diaryTexts: The envoy counted to ten in silence and returned my interest in coin and shadow.

choices.text: Accept the price of the Third Bell
choices.preview: +1 faith, +1 corruption
diaryTexts: The bell did not ring — and still the ear bled gratitude.

choices.preview: Verbal confrontation (draft); failure leads to combat.

act2/faction/culto_envoy_blades.title: Bell flesh — iron
act2/faction/culto_envoy_blades.body: [DRAFT] The **clapper** that **never** came **arrives** in the **throat**. The **Bell** **collects** in **flesh**.

choices.preview: Combat · cultist

act2/faction/culto_envoy_verbal_win.title: Bell flesh — word
act2/faction/culto_envoy_verbal_win.body: [DRAFT] The **shadow** **inclines** its head. This is not **forgiveness** — it is **debt** **acknowledged** with **another** **silence**.
onEnterDiaryTexts: [DRAFT] The rumor retreated — the Bell noted without bleeding the corridor.

act2/faction/vigilia_envoy.title: Distant beacon — Vigil
act2/faction/vigilia_envoy.body:
A **cloak-bearer** tilts the lantern. The metal does not shine — it **accuses**.

*"What the depths name, the Vigil **repeats** in a lower voice."*

choices.text: Accept military pay and the wrist grip
choices.preview: Temporary bonus · AGI
diaryTexts: A cloak-bearer closed my wrist as one closing a door — and spoke order without sermon.

choices.preview: Verbal confrontation (draft); failure leads to combat.

act2/faction/vigilia_envoy_blades.title: Distant beacon — iron
act2/faction/vigilia_envoy_blades.body: [DRAFT] The conversation **closed**. What remains is **counting** — and the **hunter** already **measures** your **step**.

choices.preview: Combat · hunter

act2/faction/vigilia_envoy_verbal_win.title: Distant beacon — word
act2/faction/vigilia_envoy_verbal_win.body: [DRAFT] The lantern **lowers** a finger. No wrist grip — only a **barracks truce**, cold as **metal** in the **damp**.
onEnterDiaryTexts: [DRAFT] The cloak-bearer yielded the path — discipline without blood this time.

act2/flee_rats.title: Flight — teeth in the boot
act2/flee_rats.body:
You slip on **slime** that forgives no step. **Bites** tear leather where armor does not reach — this is not honor; it is **survival**.

The swarm **laughs** in shrill tones — or perhaps your ear **breaks** first.

choices.text: Frighten fear itself and return to the crossroads

onEnterDiaryTexts: I fled the rats. The floor remembered my taste — and I left a trail.

act2/flee_skeleton.title: Flight — bones in pursuit
act2/flee_skeleton.body:
The skeleton **does not tire** — you do. Every **crack** behind you sounds like **questions** you do not want to answer.

At the bend, a **loose bone** rolls under your feet — the floor **collaborates** with the enemy.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I ran from a dead thing that walked too fast.

act2/hub_catacomb.title: Crossroads — hub
act2/hub_catacomb.body:
Candles and **wax** hold your step at the crossroads; *today is **day {{day}}** below.*

An **echo** of a bell rises from the depths and dies before reaching the city — as if the **silence** down there **ate** the sound and only let through enough to remind you there are still ears.

choices.preview: Still squeaking and smelling of nest.
Strange trade; price in gold or secret — rarely appears on the first day.

choices.text: Beacon — Vigil voice at the crossroads
choices.preview: Strong reputation with the order — or open enmity. Once only.
Circle of trust or hostile ash. Once only.
Devotion or rupture with the Third Bell. Once only.
A voice in the shadow offers company.
The Circle charges presence; corruption takes note.
Fire, prayer, and a breath of supply.
Move through the tunnels — stress rises; encounters possible.
Old memory; skill and luck weigh — but the echo fades if you linger too long.

choices.text: Study the crossroads: marks on the floor
choices.preview: Read the floor as a map of those who passed before.

choices.text: Pry at candle wax — trapped coin (once)
choices.preview: +1 gold; no combat.

choices.text: Listen to an echo whispering the day
choices.preview: Dry voice at the crossroads; diary entry.
choices.lockedHint: You need level 6 and must hear this before day 6 — after that the echo falls silent.
diaryTexts: A voice trapped in the ceiling: "You are already on day {{day}}."

choices.preview: Chapter 3 — the dungeon tightens the silence.
choices.lockedHint: You need level 5 and must find the threshold on the perimeter map (exploration from the crossroads).

act2/hub_mira_banter.title: Crossroads — words with Mira
act2/hub_mira_banter.body:
**Mira** rests the sword on her shoulder as one holding a cheap secret: "This place **charges** every step. I already left a name here — I will not leave yours **for free**."

The echo agrees, but does not say to whom it belongs.

choices.preview: You resume the post of decision.

act2/hub_observe.title: Marks
act2/hub_observe.body:
On the floor: **three parallel furrows**, like scratches from large claws. Beside them, **human footprints** turn back — someone gave up halfway.

A tiny **bell** was driven into the stone, rusted.

choices.text: Talk to Mira about the crossroads
choices.preview: She already knows the price of this floor.

act2/lore/lore_crossroads.title: Echo of oaths
act2/lore/lore_crossroads.body:
A **voice** without owner asks what you were and what you accept becoming. The air **weighs** like a wet mantle; the stones **remember** oaths others broke before you.

There is no map for this — only **decisions** the game records in flesh.

choices.text: Accept the name of Fallen Knight (knight)
choices.preview: Trial · fallen angel; title only if you win

choices.text: Accept the title of Dark Mage (arcanist)
choices.preview: Trial · fallen angel; title only if you win
Trial · fallen angel; title only if you win

choices.text: Plunge your arm into the whispering mire
choices.preview: Luck — 2d6 + LCK · without deciding, you withdraw to the crossroads.

diaryTexts: The crossroads reminded me of the name I accepted: fallen, but still standing.
Shadows ask no permission — I gave anyway.

choices.preview: Mind — sustain the memory (TN 8)

act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_fail.title: Truncated echo
act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_fail.body: The voice **unravels** before forming a sentence. You are left with the **weight** without the **name** — like one who prays and forgets the last word.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I tried to recall the penitent; only the cold of stone came to me.

act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_mind.title: Memory that weighs
act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_mind.body:
The echo asks for a **name** — not your baptismal one, but the one you chose when guilt **sat** beside you.

If the memory comes **ordered**, perhaps it will leave you something beyond ash.
act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_mind.skillCheckLabel: Sustain the penitent's memory without breaking

act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_success.title: Confession that stays
act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_success.body: The memory **settles** — not as victory, but as **truth** you can bear without lying to yourself.
onEnterDiaryTexts: Every stone here confesses better than I do.

act2/luck_mire.title: The whispering mire
act2/luck_mire.body: The **mire** is not water: it is cheap **memory** that promises strength and collects on your **luck**. Reach out — the dice **decide** whether you return whole.
act2/luck_mire.luckCheckLabel: Touch the mire without being devoured

act2/luck_mire_safe.title: Thread of luck
act2/luck_mire_safe.body: The mire **releases** your arm as one who **loses** interest. You are left with a false **warmth** in your muscles — **brief**, but enough for one more punch.

choices.text: Withdraw and return to the crossroads

onEnterDiaryTexts: The mire gave me a thread of strength — I do not know how long it lasts.

act2/luck_mire_wound.title: Well's bite
act2/luck_mire_wound.body: Something **scrapes** tendon and **confidence** at once. It is not only pain — it is **warning** carved into the **agile** posture you once had.

choices.text: Drag yourself back to the crossroads

onEnterDiaryTexts: The mire bit my leg. The warmth does not return the same.

act2/merchant/merchant_ask.title: Origin
act2/merchant/merchant_ask.body:
"From an **archive** that no longer exists," he murmurs. "The archive burned. The **map** remembered how to survive."

For a second, the hood **swells** — there is no wind.

choices.preview: Weapon · for inventory

choices.text: Refuse and return to the hub

act2/merchant/merchant_circle_bet.title: Symbols that bite
act2/merchant/merchant_circle_bet.body:
The hood **inclines** for a **wager**; you whisper **symbols** and the air **learns** the pattern — someone invisible **holds** the dice.

*The Circle lends luck; whoever mistimes pays in another coin.* **Roll luck** (−1 to total: **debt** already counted).
act2/merchant/merchant_circle_bet.luckCheckLabel: Either the Circle pays, or it collects in secret

act2/merchant/merchant_circle_lose.title: Price outside the purse
act2/merchant/merchant_circle_lose.body:
The pattern **slips** one **symbol** too late. Something **pulls** from your purse — **not** a human hand.

When you **see** clearly again, **two coins** are missing and **wet** laughter **echoes** beneath the hood.

choices.text: Accept the loss and return to the crossroads
diaryTexts: The symbols demanded more than I whispered — two coins gone, and a cold left behind that is not gold.

act2/merchant/merchant_circle_win.title: The hood pays
act2/merchant/merchant_circle_win.body:
The symbols **close** before the curse **tightens**. A **warm** coin falls into your palm — paid by the Circle, not you.

The merchant does **not laugh**. He only **nods**.

choices.text: Collect the gold and return to the crossroads
diaryTexts: The hood inclined: the Circle paid in coin — this time the symbols closed in my favor.

act2/merchant/merchant_moon.title: Faceless merchant
act2/merchant/merchant_moon.body:
A hood **without face** extends a **map** with gnawed margins. The fingers beneath the cloth are **too long** to be merely human.

It smells your **haste** — the haste of one who does not wish to return to the city empty-handed.

"Rumors change **weights**," says the voice — as if the air came from the stone itself.

If someone **recognizes** you among the factions, the price ceases to be only gold — it becomes **gaze**.

choices.preview: Weapon · for inventory
Consumable · reduces stress
Rest is also part of battle
Resource · single stock
A true find
Supply · Vigil seal (once at this stall)

choices.text: Ask where the map came from

choices.preview: Diary · rumor of respect
choices.lockedHint: The Vigil only gives you that hook when reputation with them is strong (≥2).
diaryTexts: The merchant hesitated when I spoke of the Vigil — interest buys silence.

choices.preview: Luck test · cursed wager
choices.lockedHint: The Circle only hears whispers from those who already owe them attention (reputation ≥1).

choices.text: Let the Third Bell name the price
choices.preview: +1 corruption, diary (once)
diaryTexts: A dry laugh beneath the cloth — the cult favors those who already hear the same echo.

act2/path_cleric_penitent.title: Penitent Cleric
act2/path_cleric_penitent.body: Incense **burns** finer when guilt **breathes** with you. You are no lesser servant — you are **more** truthful than the psalm allows.
onEnterDiaryTexts: The Vigil asks for proof; I offer scars I have already prayed over in a low voice.

act2/path_knight_fallen.title: Fallen Knight
act2/path_knight_fallen.body: The **angel** unravels into **ash** that does not burn. Iron does **not** forgive; neither do you. From here on, whoever sees you reads **fall** where they once read wall.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I defeated the veil angel with steel; I accepted the name Fallen Knight — not as excuse, but as broken promise.

act2/path_mage_dark.title: Dark Mage
act2/path_mage_dark.body: The angel's **broken light** **feeds** what you carry: the Tower **measures** light, the dungeon **teaches** what it will not pay for. Your notebook gains **margins** no scriptorium would approve.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I tore the fallen angel's veil; the safe symbols grew small. I carry the others in blood and silence.

act2/rats_choice.title: Squeak in the dark
act2/rats_choice.body:
**Squeaking** too loud to be only wind. **Red** eyes in the dark move as a group — there is not one rodent, there is **a decision** with teeth.

The floor is **damp**; old human footprints mix with small paws.

choices.preview: Combat: starving rodents.

choices.text: Listen to the sound before advancing
Smell the air: blood or mold?

act2/rats_listen.title: Listen
act2/rats_listen.body:
The squeaking **breaks** into pattern — almost language. For an instant they seem to **whisper** how many steps you have left.

Something **larger** creaks deeper in, but does not move.

act2/rats_smell.title: Smell
act2/rats_smell.body:
**Mold** first, then **iron** — and finally a false sweetness, like heated **copper**.

It is not fresh blood. It is **old blood** that never fully dried.
onEnterDiaryTexts: Smell of old flesh and fear.

act2/recruit_mira.title: Mira Joins the Group
act2/recruit_mira.body: Mira adjusts her dagger. "Less talk. **More foot**."

act2/recruit_offer.title: Mira's Offer
act2/recruit_offer.body: **Mira** watches from the shadows: "I need someone who does not fear silence."

choices.preview: Commitment in shadow — or silence decides.
choices.lockedHint: With the Circle too deep inside you (rep ≥2), this invitation closes — use the other line.

choices.text: Recruit Mira with the Circle as witness
choices.preview: The web charges visibility — the Vigil grows suspicious.
choices.lockedHint: Only when the Circle trusts you enough (rep ≥2) can you sign with witnesses.
diaryTexts: Mira laughed softly: the Circle likes when someone signs in ash.

act2/skeleton_room.title: Room of Armed Bones
act2/skeleton_room.body: Armed remains rise by **habit**, not by will.

choices.text: Trail of iron in the gloom — a silhouette watches, unmoving
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation with Kael (draft); failure leads to steel.
